name: page-route
summary: Render one view when the URL matches a path.

npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

guidance: Choose hash mode before mounting routes in static apps and use native anchors with href="#/path". Use history mode with a server fallback for deep links.
Add exact="false" to a parent route to match descendant paths. Child paths extend the parent pattern.
Use the component property for an imported view or function. Use src for a file URL or registered module key.
Inactive route content is detached and may be cached and remounted on revisit. Test component lifecycle on Back.
